title: Surviving The Sanctions
summary:
Russia adjusts to changes in global oil markets
The Russia - Ukraine war started on 24 February 2022, when Moscow invaded its neighbor. The invasion triggered widespread condemnation, and a coalition of over 40 countries has imposed coordinated economic sanctions on Russia as a result. This international response consists primarily of the "G7+ coalition," which includes all major Western economies and several key Asian and Pacific nations.
